cleaner.label: Maven (Java)
cleaner.description: Local repository and distributions downloaded by the Maven wrapper. Does not touch settings.xml or projects.

option.label: Maven local repository
option.description: Removes all the artifacts in the .m2\repository folder: downloaded dependencies and locally installed artifacts.
option.warning: Dependencies are re-downloaded on the next build. Artifacts installed with `mvn install` exist only in this folder and are lost: if you have not published them elsewhere, run `mvn install` again from their project.

option.label: Maven wrapper distributions
option.description: Removes the Maven versions downloaded by mvnw.
